S4-1b.title: The SIGN of an interaction claim is decided by unrecorded ordering
S4-1b.detail: Under one fixed non-commutative ground truth, a campaign that happened to run A-then-B computes an interaction of +0.078 and reports SYNERGY; a campaign that happened to run B-then-A computes -0.043 and reports ANTAGONISM. Both record the identical interventions payload {'component':'A+B'}. This is worse than an unmeasured effect: it is a claim whose SIGN is determined by a degree of freedom the fossil record does not retain, so two honest teams analysing the same system would publish opposite mechanisms and neither could audit the other.
